license_policy: Three distinct CC0 field recordings; verification source links included; original WAV source is NOT downloaded
media_quality_policy: All three public Freesound HQ previews were MP3/lossy, not source WAV. The exact previously reviewed 600-second MP3 bytes are now owner-approved for playback, despite unknown original source encodings and disclosed Tin Roof low average level / repeated Distant Thunder events. Digital transcoding does NOT restore original quality; a lossless WAV-based remaster would be an independent future task.
goal: Three distinct 10-minute owner-approved CC0 MP3 previews have been promoted byte-for-byte to live audio; no new SEO indexed pages
